title: cerastium fontanum f. glutinosum
intro: Cerastium fontanum f. glutinosum, commonly known as sticky mouse-ear, is a plant species within the carnation family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and soothing skin irritations, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium fontanum f. glutinosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Although more research is needed to confirm its effects, preliminary studies suggest that Cerastium fontanum f. glutinosum may have potential in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions.
